title: Parners in Galactic Tyranny
front_description: Count Dooku's solar sailer glides into a secret landing platform on Coruscant. He emerges from the craft, walks over to the hooded, sinister figure of Darth Sidious, and bows. "Welcome home, Lord Tyranus," Sidious tells him. "You have done well." The gratified Dooku walks alongside his superior, pleased to report that "the war" has begun. "Excellent," responds a smiling Sidious. "Everything is going as planned."
back_description: Christopher Lee and Ian McDiarmid perform against a bluescreen backdrop.
